title: Customer Engagement for Life Sciences Cloud Developer Reference
summary: Developer API reference for the Salesforce-native life sciences CRM platform (Spring 2025, API v63.0), documenting the standard object model across account management, activity plans, compliance, consent, data change requests, document management, and field email domains.

findings.account_management_objects: Core account management uses standard platform objects: BusinessLicense and BusinessLicenseProduct for HCP licensing, ContactPointAddress and ContactPointBestContactTime for multi-address and scheduling data, ContactPointSocial for social presence, Formulary and FormularyItem for drug formulary tracking, HealthcareProvider for HCP profiles, PartyPublication for publication tracking, ProviderAcctProductInfo and ProviderAcctTerritoryInfo for provider-product and territory assignments, ProviderAffiliation and ProviderAffiliationProduct for institutional affiliations, PrvdAccountUserGroupInfo for user group assignments.
findings.activity_plan_objects: Activity planning domain: ActivityPlan (plan definition with territory scope), ActivityPlanTerritory (territory associations), ProviderActivityGoal (provider-level activity targets), ProviderActivityGoalMeasure (quantitative measures against goals), ProviderActivityMeasureType (measure type definitions), ProviderActvtyPlanAdjusment (plan modification records), PrvdActvtyGoalMeasureProdt (product-level goal measures), TimePeriod (planning period definitions). This object model supports the full cycle of planning, execution tracking, and adjustment.
findings.compliance_and_consent: Compliance: ComplianceStatementDef for defining regulatory statements. Consent management: CommSubscription (communication subscription definitions), CommSubscriptionConsent (subscriber consent records), CommSubConsentCmplSnpsht (consent compliance snapshots), ContactPointConsent (consent at contact point level), DataUsePurpose (purpose definitions for data processing). This structure supports GDPR-style consent management with snapshot-based compliance auditing.
findings.data_change_requests: Data stewardship: LifeSciDataChangeDef (change request type definitions), LifeSciDataChangeRequest (individual change requests), LifeSciDataChgDefMngFld (managed field specifications per change type), LifeSciDataChgDefRecType (record type associations), LifeSciDataChgPersonaDef (persona-based access definitions). Enables controlled data modification workflows with approval gates and field-level control.
findings.document_and_email: Document management: DocumentTemplate, LifeSciDocTemplateVersion (versioned templates), LifeScienceDocument (document records), LifeScienceDocumentTemplate (template definitions). Field email: LifeScienceEmail (email records with tracking), LifeSciEmailTemplate (email template definitions), LifeSciEmailTmplFragment (reusable email content fragments). Additional domains include app alerts (AppAlert, AppAlertTerritory, AppAlertUserResponse, RecordAlert) for in-app notification management.
findings.api_characteristics: All objects follow standard platform API conventions: SOQL queryable, available via REST and SOAP APIs, support bulk operations. Objects use relationship fields (lookup and master-detail) following the platform's referential integrity model. Field-level security and sharing rules apply per the standard security model. No custom namespace prefix on standard objects.

source: Customer Engagement for Life Sciences Cloud Developer Guide (Pilot), Version 63.0, Spring 2025
